name: bb-plugin-makosh-remote-hub
description: Experimental SSH/RDP manager: SSH in xterm and RDP on a canvas (strict TLS, NLA, input, screenshots) through a Rust helper.
author: Mesteriis

bb.name: Remote Hub [Experimental]
bb.description: Experimental SSH/RDP manager: SSH in xterm and RDP on a canvas (strict TLS, NLA, input, screenshots) through a Rust helper.

scripts.build:helper: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/home/builder --remap-path-prefix=$PWD=/src $RUSTFLAGS" cargo build --release --locked --target aarch64-apple-darwin --manifest-path helper/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p bin && cp helper/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/remote-hub-helper bin/remote-hub-helper && chmod +x bin/remote-hub-helper && node scripts/helper-sums.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.test:integration: cargo build --features test-hooks --manifest-path helper/Cargo.toml && REMOTE_HUB_HELPER="$PWD/helper/target/debug/remote-hub-helper" python3 tests/integration/ssh-docker.py && REMOTE_HUB_HELPER="$PWD/helper/target/debug/remote-hub-helper" python3 tests/integration/rdp-docker.py && REMOTE_HUB_INTEGRATION=1 REMOTE_HUB_HELPER=helper/target/debug/remote-hub-helper vitest run tests/integration/ssh-service.test.ts tests/integration/rdp-probe.test.ts tests/integration/rdp-service.test.ts tests/integration/credential-leak.test.ts tests/integration/ssh-askpass.test.ts tests/integration/agent-control.test.ts
